subject: Post-demo recap: Trial runway, success criteria & hosting options
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@healthsync.ai>, Tina Lopez <tina.lopez@healthsync.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo recap: Trial runway, success criteria & hosting options

Hi Sam / Tina —

Thanks again for taking the product walkthrough earlier today. Per our conversation I captured a practical trial runway and the hosting options so we can pick the fastest path to measurable results. See the short plan below and the attached trial matrix + terms.

Quick recap of goals (you confirmed these on the call):
- Verify inference latency and tail behavior on representative patient-note prompts (95th percentile target: <= 300ms)
- Validate embedding accuracy for semantic search across 2M clinical notes (target: top-5 recall > 92%)
- Confirm end-to-end integration with your pipeline (SSO, audit logs, encrypted at rest)
- Measure cost per 1M tokens & expected throughput for 100 concurrent sessions

Suggested evaluation phases (total ~6 weeks):
1) Smoke (1 week): basic connectivity, auth, small prompt set — hosted API recommended for fastest start.
2) Functional (2 weeks): embedding tests, prompt permutations, tooling checks. Start can be hosted or dedicated sandbox.
3) PHI validation & load (3 weeks): For PHI and full-load we'd run in your VPC/private deployment. We can also do a hybrid: start hosted to iterate quickly, then move to VPC for PHI-sensitive workloads.

Hosting options (brief):
- Hosted API (fastest): immediate access, no infra on your side. Good for early functional tests.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool): predictable throughput for load tests without full VPC setup.
- VPC / Private deployment: customer-managed network for PHI, integrates with KMS/HSM, audit logs retained per your policy.

Recommended path (our product suggestion): Start with Hosted for the smoke + early functional work (1–2 weeks), then migrate to Dedicated sandbox for load profiling and finally to VPC for PHI validation. The attached trial matrix lists what we need from your side for each step.

Action items / asks from HealthSync:
- Confirm which hosting option you prefer to start with by EOD Nov 24 (hosted || dedicated-sandbox || vpc)
- Share a short sample of the prompt/embedding dataset (anonymized) for preliminary profiling
- Let us know stakeholders for procurement + security (we've cc'd Rishi to coordinate any sensitive items)

Attachments: healthsync_trial_runway_matrix.xlsx, redwood_trial_terms_v2.pdf, soc2_audit_summary.pdf

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff for next week to lock down owners/timeline.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Park <sam.park@healthsync.ai>

Date: 2026-11-21T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: Trial runway, success criteria & hosting options

Thanks Monica — solid recap. A few clarifying questions before we commit to a path:

1) PHI / compliance: We need SOC2 Type II evidence and confirmation that audit logs (per-request metadata) can be exported to our SIEM. Do you have a standard export format?
2) Cost: Can you ballpark the incremental cost to run the Dedicated sandbox for 3 weeks of load testing vs Hosted during that period? We need a rough estimate for procurement.
3) SSO and networking: We use Okta + private IP ranges. Will we be able to point-to-point to a sandbox or do you require an initial VPN setup?

Preference: Because we plan to run tests with de-identified notes first but will move to PHI for the final validation, my preference is VPC for the PHI phase. If a hybrid approach is safest, fine — but we need the SOC2/audit answers before we hand this to security.

Can we do a 30-min kickoff Wednesday (Nov 24) at 11am PT? Tina will coordinate procurement.

—Sam
Sam Park
Head of Platform Engineering, HealthSync
sam.park@healthsync.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@healthsync.ai>, Tina Lopez <tina.lopez@healthsync.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: Trial runway, success criteria & hosting options

Appreciate the questions — answers below and a proposed mutual action plan inside.

1) SOC2 / audit logs: We have a current SOC2 Type II report (attachment: soc2_audit_summary.pdf). Audit logs (per-request metadata, timestamps, model-id, token counts) can be exported as JSONL to your SIEM; we also support S3 delivery or syslog forwarding via a secured collector. We'll include the export schema in the trial matrix.

2) Cost estimate (high-level):
- Hosted API (3 weeks of functional + light load): estimated incremental cost ~$1.2k – $2.5k depending on token volumes.
- Dedicated sandbox (3 weeks of focused load testing with reserved GPUs): estimated incremental cost ~$12k – $18k (includes reserved capacity ramp and egress where applicable).
These are preliminary — Rishi, can you confirm GPU slot availability and firm pricing for a 3-week reservation?

3) Networking / SSO: For Okta we support SAML SSO; we can add HealthSync as an IdP in our console. For private connectivity we support two options: (A) temporary VPN peering for the dedicated sandbox, or (B) full VPC deployment for PHI. The sandbox VPN typically takes 3–5 business days to stand up if you provide IP allowlist and tunnel endpoints.

Proposed mutual action plan (summary):
- Week 0 (prep, 2–3 days): Share anonymized sample data + finalize start environment (Hosted || Dedicated). Procure trial terms (DocuSign link below).
- Week 1–2 (functional): Run embedding tests, tune prompts, confirm metric baselines on Hosted.
- Week 3–5 (load & PHI validation): Move to Dedicated sandbox / VPC; run parallel load tests and security validation.
- Week 6 (review): Joint review, decision on production path (Dedicated or Private).

Links / resources:
- Sandbox signup: https://app.redwood.ai/sandbox/signup?team=healthsync
- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCD-TRIAL-2026
- Trial matrix (attached): healthsync_trial_runway_matrix.xlsx

Next step: Monica to schedule kickoff for Wed Nov 24 11am PT (tentative). Tina — if that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include Rishi + Laura.

Thanks —
Monica

--

Subject: RE: Post-demo recap: Trial runway, success criteria & hosting options (internal)

Rishi / Laura — quick internal note following yesterday's external thread and Sam's preference for a VPC for PHI.

Summary of asks from HealthSync:
- Hybrid approach: start hosted for functional work, then spin up Dedicated sandbox or VPC for PHI and load tests.
- Procurement will need a 3-week dedicated sandbox price to compare vs Hosted.
- SOC2 evidence + per-request audit log export required.

Proposals / asks for internal owners:
- Rishi: can we confirm 3-week reserved sandbox pricing and available slot window between Dec 6–20? If slots are tight, propose bump to Jan 2027 but we should list trade-offs.
- Laura: can you prepare a short procurement packet (SOW + pricing sheet + short checklist) I can send to HealthSync procurement? Target: draft by EOD Nov 25.

If we can get quick alignment I will send the DocuSign and calendar invite (Wed 11am PT) today.
